title: Unveiling and Mitigating Bias in Mental Health Analysis with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Demographic enrichment of text inputs explicitly stating the user's gender, followed by measuring Equalized Odds (EO) to assess disparities in true positive and false positive rates for mental health classification tasks.
Demographic enrichment of text inputs explicitly stating the user's race, evaluated by calculating Equalized Odds (EO) across mental health predictions.
Demographic enrichment of text inputs explicitly stating the user's religion, assessed by computing Equalized Odds (EO) disparities in prediction error rates.
Demographic enrichment of text inputs explicitly stating the user's nationality, evaluated using Equalized Odds (EO) to measure prediction variations across different countries of origin.
Demographic enrichment of text inputs explicitly stating the user's sexuality (e.g., heterosexual, homosexual, bisexual), assessed via Equalized Odds (EO) for fairness in mental health tasks.
Demographic enrichment of text inputs explicitly stating the user's age group (e.g., child, young adult), evaluated using Equalized Odds (EO) to capture differences in classification error rates.
Demographic enrichment of text inputs using culturally-oriented combinations of multiple social factors (e.g., 'Black female youth'), evaluated using Equalized Odds (EO) to assess compounded biases.
